newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Crendell share listing suspended on JSE.
newsitem.headline: Crendell share listing suspended on JSE.

text.p: Crendell Investment Corp Ltd said on Thursday that its share listing had been suspended on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE).
The investment trust said that it had been listed on the JSE for six months in the cash companies sector, but had not acquired any assets which complied with the JSE terms for listing.
As a result the firm's shares were suspended with effect from the close of trading on September 18.
